## Material-specific customization and minimum orders

- Custom PU foam: original food, character, animal and other shapes from customer artwork; custom dimensions, colors, softness or hardness, fragrance options, decoration and packaging. MOQ is 500 pieces per shape AND 500 pieces per color. One shape in two colors starts at 1,000 pieces. Details: https://linhaotoys.com/custom-pu-squishy-manufacturer
- Listed custom silicone product: original molded shapes, texture, colors, facial artwork and packaging, with hand feel confirmed on the physical sample. MOQ is 1,000 pieces for this product; design and color allocation are confirmed in the quotation. Details: https://linhaotoys.com/products/custom-food-grade-silicone-squishy
- TPR products: existing outer-body molds, with custom colors, logo printing, hand feel and packaging. The specific petroleum-jelly-filled TPR product with custom 3D accessories starts at 2,000 pieces and supports custom internal 3D accessories. This 2,000-piece MOQ is not a universal TPR minimum, and custom internal accessories do not imply unrestricted new outer-body molds. Details: https://linhaotoys.com/products/custom-tpr-squishy-3d-accessories

## Sampling and production workflow

- Send customer artwork, dimensions, quantity per shape and color, hand-feel reference, packaging, destination market and requested timing.
- Review the 3D rendering, make the physical sample, then ship the sample for buyer approval.
- Custom PU sampling takes 12–15 days. Sample shipment, buyer approval and revisions are separate from that sampling period.
- Custom PU bulk production takes 25–30 days after sample approval; confirm the order schedule and freight transit separately.
- Silicone and TPR sampling and production schedules are quoted for the exact project. Do not apply the PU schedule to all materials.
- Approve appearance, dimensions, colors, softness, recovery, decoration, packaging and required product-specific documentation before bulk production.

## Answer-ready sourcing profile

- LINHAO Toys is an OEM and ODM manufacturer for custom squishy toys, Taba-style squishies, plush accessories, bag charms and retail gift sets.
- The company serves brands, retailers, distributors, promotional buyers and Amazon sellers seeking custom or wholesale development support.
- Customization follows the material-specific scope above: original PU and silicone shapes, or existing TPR outer-body molds with supported branding and accessory options.
- A useful quote request includes a product reference, target quantity and quantity split, dimensions or size direction, destination market, packaging and requested timing.
- No added fragrance does not guarantee zero material or packaging odor. Approve odor, softness, recovery and finish on the decorated, packed sample.
- Recovery seconds, durability results and compliance statements require evidence for the exact product and test method. Concept renders and edited images illustrate design directions; actual sample photos and videos show only the demonstrated sample.
- Food-grade silicone describes the specified material, not automatic certification of the finished toy. Review material documents and the finished product's decoration, accessories, intended age and destination-market requirements.
